hero.heading: How El Portal works.
hero.body: A method, not a vibe. Five mechanics, layered. The system reads, organizes, and surfaces signal, leaving you to stay focused on the work that earns it.

scales.name: Version
scales.role: The arc, representing who you're becoming.
bullets: Runs for as long as the identity takes.

scales.name: Cycle
scales.role: The sprint, defining what to work on now.
bullets: Aimed at the problems and skills that identity demands.

scales.name: Day
scales.role: The reps, the only scale you actually live in.
bullets: Atomic, with one set of habits and one score.

dailyScore.heading: One number, honestly weighted.
dailyScore.body: Every habit carries a weight. Your day rolls up into a single number, not a streak count or a vibe, representing the share of the weight you actually moved.

weightTiers.body: Frictionless. Cheap to maintain, easy to lose.
Repeatable. The middle of the habit stack.
Costly. The work that actually moves the cycle.

pulseLoop.heading: Twice a day.
pulseLoop.body: Morning frames intent. Evening logs reality. The gap between the two is where the signal lives.
pulseLoop.subBody: Two short check-ins build the dataset the rest of the system reads from.

morning.label: Morning check-in
morning.intro: Four short steps. Each one calibrates the day before the day begins.

steps.label: Mood
steps.body: Where you are right now, on a calm scale.

steps.label: Sleep
steps.body: Quality of the night that just ended.

steps.label: Feelings
steps.body: What's actually present, selected from a bank of named emotions.

steps.label: Focus
steps.body: The one thing you want today to be about.

evening.label: Evening check-in
evening.intro: Eight short steps. The evening pass is denser because the evening has the data.

steps.label: Mood
steps.body: Where you landed after the day's work.

steps.label: Productivity
steps.body: How much of the day actually compounded.

steps.label: Stress
steps.body: Load you carried, not the load you planned.

steps.label: Motivation
steps.body: Pull toward the work, or against it.

steps.label: Connectedness
steps.body: Time spent in the people who matter.

steps.label: Feelings
steps.body: Named emotions from the same bank as morning.

steps.label: Activities
steps.body: What you actually did — for the trend layer to read.

habitsAndGoals.heading: Two primitives. Different time scales.
habitsAndGoals.body: Habits are the daily atoms. Goals are the cycle-scoped outcomes. Together they cover both ends of the practice.

habits.heading: Habits
habits.body: Weighted recurring actions. They feed the daily score and the consistency layer beneath it.
bullets: Three weight tiers: LOW (1), MEDIUM (2), and HIGH (4).
Recurrence configured per habit, not assumed.
Don't auto-carry between cycles, remaining deliberate by design.

goals.heading: Goals
goals.body: Outcomes you commit to inside a single Cycle. Two kinds, each with its own definition of done.
bullets: task_project, with bounded scope, finished or not.
consistency_metric, representing a rate you hold across the cycle.
Carry across cycles via lineage, keeping the same goal across multiple cycles.

carryOver.label: Carry-over
carryOver.body: Goals can travel across cycles via a lineage link, keeping the same journey across multiple sprints. Habits start fresh each cycle, by choice.

trendsInsights.heading: The system reads the data you generate.
trendsInsights.body: A correlation engine and a set of pattern detectors look for repeating signals across your habits, vitals, and feelings, writing them up plainly.

insightCard.title: Sleep quality → next-day mood
insightCard.body: Nights you sleep above your median predict a higher mood the morning after. Strong, repeated across the last two cycles.

detectors.name: Burnout
detectors.body: Energy drops sharply over three days against a two-week baseline.

detectors.name: Regression
detectors.body: A habit you held for a week or more has dropped to zero for three days running.

detectors.name: Weekday Blind Spot
detectors.body: A habit you nail most days collapses on a single day of the week.

detectors.name: Sleep Lag
detectors.body: A night of low sleep predicts a measurable drop in next-day performance.

closing.body: The method is the floor, and the convictions underneath it are what make it worth running.
